name: water-brush-slope-shallow
description: test.md 'Water brush rim heights': one Shallow Water click, size 3, on sloping ground (fixtures/we-specs/slope.w3x, the ground rising 6 world units a corner along x), at the same screen position in both editors (the terrain view at the editor's opening camera). KNOWN DIFFERENCE (2026-11-13, 71 corners): the editor sets the ground of 47 corners round the click (the 13 water corners and a rim of 34, all within about 4 corners) to the height of the clicked corner; Studio moves only some rim corners (nearest wet corner: 34 ground differences); and the editor gives the rim corners cliff type 1 where Studio gives 0 (37). The layers and water words match. Expected to differ until Studio flattens as the editor does

name: water-brush-slope-deep

name: water-brush-slope-shallow-east
